dedupe_keys.name: donnees theoriques gtfs et temps reel siri lite du reseau cts

description: Données théoriques (GTFS) et temps réel (SIRI-lite) du réseau CTS is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CTS - Compagnie des Transports Strasbourgeois. This dataset contains theoretical data related to stops/routes/timetables (GTFS format) as well as real-time APIs (SIRI lite format). In order to request real-time APIs it is necessary to have an account allowing the generation of a token. Coverage: CTS - Compagnie des Transports Strasbourgeois. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical data (GTFS) and real-time data (SIRI-lite) of the CTS network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CTS - Compagnie des Transports Strasbourgeois. Its keywords include strasbourg, eurometropole, horaires-temps-reel, siri-lite, horaires-theoriques, gtfs. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SIRI-LITE, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-11-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
